a hierarchical clustering approach enables a scalable embedding approach for very large graphs, and that the resulting embeddings outperforms existing approaches for a range of network analysis tasks, including link prediction, node classification and visualization of hierarchical structures.

we have developed a novel scalable hierarchical embedding approach that can accurately embed very large networks and that outperforms state-of-the-art scalable embedding methods in terms of predictive performance and visualization.

we have developed and demonstrated the accuracy of a novel multiscale likelihood estimate of Latent Distance Modeling for graph embedding that scales in complexity with O(NlogN) allowing for embedding and analysis of very large networks in a low dimensional space with high accuracy.

the development of scalable hierarchical embeddings of complex networks and the use of these embeddings to predict network structure and infer network properties.
the development of a new scalable hierarchical embedding approach for complex networks and its application in order to understand their structure and properties.

the development of a novel scalable hierarchical network embedding approach that is able to accurately embed large networks in low dimensions while providing detailed insights into their hierarchical structure.
